title: US equity markets close early at 1:00 p.m. ET — Monday before Independence Day 2028
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes; needs curl -L, and its holiday data parses as JSON-ish '"text":"..."' cells rather than HTML table markup). The 2028 column of the Independence Day row reads 'Tuesday, July 4**', and footnote ** reads verbatim: 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Monday, July 3, 2028. NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m. All times are Eastern Time.' The date is READ from the footnote, not derived. Independently consistent with statute: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Independence Day on July 4, which in 2028 is a Tuesday, leaving the Monday as the shortened session. Filed estimate on the same two counts every sibling half-day entry records: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs has no slot for an exchange operator's own hours page (open issue #2552), and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of thanksgiving-half-day-2028-11-24, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the thanksgiving-half-day-2028-11-24 initial research (2026-09-09). It is not bookkeeping — it is load-bearing for the proposer's own ledger. That ledger's structural leg turns on how many early closes 2028 has: the 2027 sibling's headline structural fact was that 2027-11-26 is the ONLY NYSE early close in all of 2027, so that instance had no rehearsal. 2028 is the opposite case, and this is the other half of it — the NYSE grid's three early-close footnotes resolve for 2028 to exactly two dates, Monday July 3 2028 (this entry) and Friday November 24 2028 (the proposer), because New Year's Day 2028 falls on a Saturday with no holiday observed (footnote *) and Christmas Day 2028 is a Monday carrying no early-close footnote. So the November half day has a rehearsal five months ahead of it, and a session reading either one can calibrate on the other. WHY THIS ONE IS THE THINNER OF THE TWO ON THE MEASURED TAPE: the proposer's ledger re-derived SPY volume against its own trailing-20 median across the three half-session classes, and the July 3 class runs 0.584x (n=19) against 0.429x for the day after Thanksgiving and 0.367x for December 24 — so July 3 is the LEAST thin of the three, which is exactly why it is the honest calibration point rather than a proxy. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED: symbols is empty, impact is low, no house playbook is calendar-keyed (grep of docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md for 'holiday|half.day|early close|thanksgiving|black friday' returns 0 and 0, run 2026-09-09), and estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
